newsitem.title: HUNGARY: PAYOUT TO TVK MAY COME ONLY IN H2.
newsitem.headline: PAYOUT TO TVK MAY COME ONLY IN H2.

text.p: The earnings of Hungarian chemicals firm TVK may receive a boost from a payout by the state privatisation agency APV only in the second half of the year, a TVK official said.

"I am not sure that we will receive the money by June 30, but we will certainly get it in the first days of July," TVK financial director Margit Tallai told Reuters, adding that the payout would boost TVK's pre-tax profits.
APV announced on Wednesday that it would pay 5.281 billion forints to TVK, without disclosing when it would transfer the money.
The price of TVK shares rallied on the Budapest Stock Exchange (TVK) recently on expectations that the payout from APV would boost the company's earnings.
If the amount is transferred only after June 30, its impact will not appear in TVK's earnings report for the first half of the year, only in third quarter company figures.
TVK closed at 3,310 forints on the BSE on Wednesday.
